articles.summary: Elbit America’s BiNOD (F5035) is an affordable, ruggedized, lightweight, helmet-mounted binocular night vision system purpose-built for the modern battlefield.
articles.title: ELBIT AMERICA WINS U.S. ARMY CONTRACT TO DELIVER NEXT-GENERATION BINOCULAR NIGHT VISION SYSTEMS

articles.summary: Elbit Systems of America received a delivery order valued at $212 million to be the sole producer of the Enhanced Night Vision Goggle – Binocular (ENVG-B) systems for the United States Army. The Army has historically split production for ENVG-B systems among multiple vendors, however Elbit America was the only prime supplier selected for this delivery order.
articles.title: U.S. SOLDIERS GAIN DECISIVE EDGE WITH ADVANCED NIGHT VISION GOGGLES
